description: Complete governance interface with voting, vote viewing, and simple fast design

userStories.title: Fix clickable proposals
userStories.description: Make proposal cards clickable links that navigate to detail page
acceptanceCriteria: Hover state shows cursor:pointer and subtle bg change

userStories.title: Proposal detail - basic shell
userStories.description: Create proposal detail page with basic info
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches proposal from Gateful using useQuery
Back button links to proposals list

userStories.title: Vote counts and progress bars
userStories.description: Visual display of vote results with bars and percentages
acceptanceCriteria: Bars stack horizontally to 100% width using flexbox
High contrast colors (readable on white bg)

userStories.title: Status and time indicators
userStories.description: Show proposal status and timing clearly
acceptanceCriteria: Color-coded: green=Ongoing, blue=Executed, yellow=Pending, red=Defeated, gray=Cancelled
Time remaining for active (endTimestamp - now in days/hours)
Time ago for completed (timestamp - now in days/hours)

userStories.title: Wallet connect and voting power
userStories.description: Display user's voting power from ENS Governor
acceptanceCriteria: useAccount hook from wagmi shows connected address
useReadContract reads getVotes(address) from ENS Governor 0x323a...
Shows 'Your VP: X' on proposal detail page

userStories.title: Vote buttons and transaction
acceptanceCriteria: Only visible when wallet connected AND proposal status=ACTIVE
Read hasVoted(proposalId, address) from governor to check if user voted
If voted, show 'You voted: [direction]' instead of buttons
Clicking calls writeContract with castVote(proposalId, support)
Show loading state during tx (disable buttons, spinner)
On success: show toast, refetch proposal data
On error: show error toast with reason

userStories.title: Vote reason (optional comment)
userStories.description: Allow voters to add a comment when voting
acceptanceCriteria: If filled, use castVoteWithReason(proposalId, support, reason) instead

userStories.title: Votes tab - list of voters
userStories.description: Show who voted and how in a table
acceptanceCriteria: Tab navigation component (Description active by default, Votes, Actions)
HTML table with: Voter, Direction, Amount, Time columns
Voter: ENS name if available else truncated address (0x1234...5678)
Direction: ✅ For, ❌ Against, ➖ Abstain (based on support value)

userStories.title: Actions tab - calldata display
acceptanceCriteria: Actions tab shows targets[], values[], calldatas[] from proposal
HTML table: #, Target, Value (ETH), Calldata columns
Target: full address with copy button
Value: formatted as ETH (e.g., 0.5 ETH) using formatEther
Calldata: truncated to 50 chars with 'Expand' button to show full

userStories.title: Description tab - markdown rendering
userStories.description: Render proposal description with proper formatting
acceptanceCriteria: Description tab renders proposal.description as markdown
Code blocks: monospace font, light gray bg

userStories.title: Quorum indicator
userStories.description: Show quorum progress for proposals that require it
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate total votes: forVotes + againstVotes + abstainVotes

userStories.title: Simple fast styling
acceptanceCriteria: tailwind.config.js: minimal config, only used utilities
Use system font stack: font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
High contrast text: text-gray-900 on white
